sumInsured: As per Policy Schedule (not specified in provided extract)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: The eligible Room Rent or Room Category applicable for the Insured Person under the Policy is 'No limit', which means that there is no separate restriction on Room Charges incurred towards stay during Hospitalization
great.explanation: You can choose any room category during hospitalization without any limit on room rent charges. This means no capping or proportionate deductions will reduce your claim.

great.name: ICU Charges
great.quote: Intensive Care Unit Charges (ICU Charges): The eligible ICU Charges applicable for the Insured Person under the Policy is 'No limit', which means that there is no separate restriction on ICU Charges incurred towards stay in ICU during Hospitalization.
great.explanation: ICU charges are covered without any cap, so your ICU expenses will be paid up to the sum insured and any additional benefits.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: automatically make the re-instatement of up to the base Sum Insured unlimited times in a policy year... Recharge amount can be utilized for same illness as well as different Illnesses.
great.explanation: The sum insured can be reinstated unlimited times within the policy year, even for the same illness, giving you strong coverage for multiple claims.

great.name: NCB
great.quote: enhance the Sum Insured by 50% flat... (vi) In the event of a Claim there is no impact on the accrual of Cumulative Bonus.
great.explanation: You get a 50% increase in sum insured as cumulative bonus each claim-free year, and claims do not reduce this bonus, which helps increase your coverage over time.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: The Recharge shall be utilized only after the base Sum Insured, applicable Cumulative Bonus , Cumulative Bonus Super (if applicable) and Plus Benefit (if applicable) have been completely exhausted in that Policy Year.
great.explanation: Extra sum insured becomes available after you exhaust the base sum insured and accrued bonuses, providing a large buffer for multiple or large claims.

great.name: Specific Illness Waiting
great.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/ treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
great.explanation: Named illnesses are covered after 24 months of continuous coverage, which is a standard and acceptable waiting period.

good.name: PED Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED)... shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 36 months (3 years) of continuous coverage, which is within the acceptable 24–48 month range.

good.name: Initial Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: There is a standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses except accidents, which is common in the market.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: For a period of 60 days immediately prior to the Insured Person's date of admission to the Hospital
good.explanation: Medical expenses incurred up to 60 days before hospitalization are covered, which is a standard duration.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: For a period of 180 days immediately after the Insured Person's date of discharge from the hospital
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 180 days after discharge are covered, providing good post-hospital care coverage.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: The Company will indemnify the Insured Person... for the Medical Expenses incurred towards Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.explanation: Home-based hospitalization treatment is covered subject to conditions like minimum 3-day treatment and certain exclusions.

good.name: Air Ambulance
good.quote: The Company will indemnify the Insured Person up to the amount as specified in Policy Schedule , for the Reasonable and Customary Charges necessarily incurred on availing Air Ambulance services
good.explanation: Air ambulance services are covered as an optional benefit with limits specified in the policy schedule.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Any item or condition or treatment specified in List of Non-Medical Items (Annexure  I to Policy Terms & Conditions).
bad.reference: Clause 4.2(1) + Annexure I (List of Expenses Generally Excluded)
bad.explanation: Many consumables like gloves and masks are excluded by default, increasing your out-of-pocket costs unless you opt for the Claim Shield benefit.

bad.name: Disease Sub-limits
bad.quote: For diseases or conditions or procedure that have a specified sub-limit then all related expenses shall be covered up to the sub-limit specified for that disease or condition or procedure.
bad.explanation: If your policy schedule includes disease-wise sub-limits, claims for those conditions are capped, which can limit your claim amount.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: The Co-payment proportion ( If opted ) shall be borne by the Insured Person on each Claim
bad.reference: General Conditions Applicable To All The Benefits And Optional Benefits, point 4 + Optional Benefit 3.2.7
bad.explanation: Co-pay is mentioned as an optional feature; any mention of co-pay is a disadvantage as it means you may have to pay a portion of each claim.

unclear.name: NCB Cap
unclear.quote: the accrued Cumulative Bonus, shall not exceed 100% of the Sum Insured
unclear.explanation: Cumulative Bonus is capped at 100% of sum insured, but optional benefits may increase this; your effective bonus depends on your policy schedule.

unclear.name: Schedule-dependent Benefits
unclear.quote: Sum Insured means the amount specified in the Policy Schedule
unclear.explanation: Key values like sum insured and optional benefits depend on your policy schedule and are not specified in the document extract.
